entries.name: Cooking from a recipe in the language
entries.summary: Cook something, following the recipe in the language
entries.doesNotDo: It teaches the vocabulary of one kitchen. The consequences make you read carefully; they do not make the words general.

entries.name: A video game in the target language
entries.summary: Play something with the language switched over
entries.doesNotDo: Games are playable without reading. Once you know the interface you stop parsing the text, and the practice quietly ends while the play continues.

entries.name: Tandem or language café
entries.summary: Talk to a speaker who is also learning yours
entries.doesNotDo: Half of it is in your own language, and a patient partner will accommodate you until neither of you notices what you cannot say.

entries.name: Ordering, asking, complaining
entries.summary: Do a real errand in the language, out loud
entries.doesNotDo: It is a handful of fixed exchanges. Once they work you can repeat them for years without adding anything.

entries.name: Watching a film you know by heart
entries.summary: A film you know every line of, in the language
entries.doesNotDo: You already know what is being said. Memory does the comprehension, which is what makes it comfortable and what limits it.
